current_build.layout: 16 fixed angular slots per layer and radial position; explicit block size and start slot
current_build.legacy_migration: Versions 1-5 use consecutive 1/16 slots; versions 6-7 retain exact slots and sizes. Versions 1-6 receive the OSI design preset; version 7 retains its custom design and protocol assignments. Source backup on first save.
empty_atlas_checks: Cancellation preserves document and draft
Write failure preserves active atlas
Confirmed reset saves an empty atlas with the previous saved document backed up
Repeating reset on an empty atlas preserves its backup
placement_checks: Add here starts explicit Placing mode; Save requires a locked location
Left click locks and cancels queued hover callbacks
Locked drafts stay fixed through motion and unrelated empty clicks
Clicking a locked draft or selected saved block picks it up
Occupied drops remain Placing with a red preview
Escape restores the last locked location and preserves notes
Relocating a saved block preserves its ID and requires Save to update disk
Dragging rotates while Placing without locking or saving
slot_slider_checks: 16 snapping positions with aligned landmark labels
Live preview during drag; valid release locks and stops mouse following
Footprint highlights for every size, including wrapping from 16 to 01
Arrow keys and Home/End clamp to the slider endpoints
Blocked starts account for footprint width and exclude the selected saved block
Invalid releases cannot lock or save; Escape restores the prior lock and ignores a later release
Both sliders and the notes area fit the minimum window size
design_checks: Add, rename, reorder and recolor layers with stable IDs and equal spacing
Add, rename and remove protocols with stable IDs
Editable layer/protocol captions and three block label styles
Dynamic axis, legend, filters, geometry, picking and camera
Cancel, validation errors and write failures preserve the saved atlas
Removing used entries requires explicit reassignment; overlaps reject the operation atomically
Custom design roundtrip through saved/exported JSON
Empty atlas preserves the design and backs up the saved blocks

clear_list_checks: Remove list clears layers in the draft and requires valid layer reassignments before Apply
Remove protocols saves immediately after confirmation; blocks become unassigned with unchanged notes and geometry
No protocol is an unassigned state; an empty protocol list remains valid
Immediate removal updates editor and filters and preserves camera position
Pending layer/caption edits stay in the design draft; cancelling does not undo confirmed protocol removal
Write failure preserves saved assignments and the draft; clearing unsaved additions does not replace the backup
New blocks, Empty atlas, export/import and save-on-close work without protocols
Controls fit the minimum window size
current_build.radial_controls: One discrete radial slider; Inward and Outward buttons removed
optional_protocol_checks: Schema 8 stores unassigned protocol as null and an empty protocol list as []
Protocol addition does not automatically assign existing blocks
Explicit assignment/unassignment and No protocol filtering
A user protocol named No protocol remains selectable separately from the unassigned state
Version 7 custom designs migrate without changing protocol assignments
current_build.view_modes: Blocks is the default; Nodes is an alternative session-only view of the same atlas data
nodes_view_checks: Layer-colored spheres use the midpoint of each saved radial and angular footprint
Occupied layer/depth rings have faint, unpickable orbital guides
Selected and hovered nodes retain labels while the Labels option controls all other labels
Sphere and label clicks select saved nodes for title and note editing without moving them
Hidden larger footprints continue to reserve all of their saved slots
New nodes use dropdowns and sliders only; occupied positions disable Create node
Saved-node coordinates stay read-only until Move node unlocks layer, position and start slot
New radial nodes use a 1/16 footprint while full Center nodes sit on the layer axis
Switching views preserves dirty editor text, current draft, selection, filters and camera
Custom layers, empty protocols, Center creation and Empty atlas work in both views
current_build.nodes_interaction: New node and Move node use dropdowns and sliders with a live validity preview; viewport clicks select saved spheres and dragging rotates the camera
node_move_checks: Move node previews the existing block footprint without writing until Save move
Cancel move and Escape restore starting coordinates while keeping title and note edits
Entire footprints are checked against hidden reservations; invalid moves cannot save
Filtered destinations still preview; saving clears a filter that would hide the moved node
View switches and failed saves preserve the move draft; success preserves identity, text, size and neighbors and writes a backup
Switching notes honors Save, Discard and Cancel; templates remain read-only
Center and ring transitions retain full and partial sizes and obey occupancy rules
Move controls and the notes area fit the minimum window
connection_checks: Layer anchors bound the spine with no extension beyond the first or last anchor
Sparse adjacency joins ring neighbors and nearest nodes on the next occupied ring
Connections remain within one layer and use that layer's configured color
Selected and moving-node connections are emphasized
Filters rebuild the visible graph and the Connections checkbox hides or shows it without changing data
template_checks: Blank, Python, TypeScript, Web application, Solar system and Project planning use ordinary Atlas documents
The existing Nodes renderer provides every template preview without thumbnail graphics
Preview is read-only and never writes to disk
Cancel restores the document, editor, filters, view mode and camera
Use template saves atomically and keeps the previous saved atlas as the normal backup
Empty atlases leave the spatial view unobstructed
current_build.focus_check: Both custom sliders compare raw Tk focus paths and tolerate transient combobox popdown windows
current_build.slider_compatibility: Six radial positions including Center and all sixteen Start slot positions are available

windows_release.test_isolation: New temporary atlases; packaged executable tested with Python, virtual-environment and Tcl/Tk environment overrides removed and only System32 on PATH
windows_release.installer_checks: Per-user install, installed executable, same-version upgrade and uninstall; saved test data preserved and test registration removed
windows_release.limitations: Tested on this Windows desktop; a separate clean machine without Python has not been tested

startup_checks: main.py fresh launch creates the starter atlas
--empty does not clear an existing atlas
--empty creates a genuinely empty new atlas
startup backup recovery preserves the corrupt original
